content.text: Wire colors are indicated by an alphabetical code.
The first letter indicates the basic wire color and the second letter indicates the color of the stripe.

DISTINCTION OF MALE AND FEMALE CONNECTORS
Male and female connectors are distinguished by shape of their internal pins.
(a) All connectors are shown from the open end, and the lock is on top.

content.description: Female and male connector illustrations showing their different internal pin configurations from the open end

content.text: (b) To pull apart the connectors, pull on the connector itself, not the wires.

content.description: Illustration showing wrong and correct methods of disconnecting connectors. Wrong method shows pulling on wires. Correct method shows pulling on connector body

content.text: (a) From the open end, insert a miniature screwdriver between the locking lugs and terminal.
